mixed_blocks.interpretation: After monic K³, remaining 690 pivots all land in QK2 (690/777). The classical complete packet needed 777 QK2 pivots; with only 746 rows the QK2 block cannot fill (max non-K3 pivots = 690). No proposed relation was found that *refuses* to reduce: non-pivot QK2 monoms are simply outside the 746-row rowspan. Q2K and Q3 contribute 0 additional pivots under preferred order.

monic_K3.interpretation: All 56 pure-K³ monoms admit monic rewrite rules with tails in S·B (S=F_89[Q], B=order ideal). Hence R/J_N is generated by B as a finite S-module.

specialized_fibres.interpretation: At each of 40 random q0, the 746 specialized polys in k span all 84 monoms of degree ≤3 in 6 variables (rank 84). Since monom_vec always has constant term 1, ker of the jet map is {0}, so no affine k-solution exists for those q0 (including k=0). This is discovery evidence that V(J_N) projects into a proper closed subset of A^{37}_Q; it is not a Nullstellensatz certificate.
